lines.text: The psalm calls for a new song to the LORD because He has done wonders.
His right hand and holy arm gained Him the victory, and He revealed His righteousness to the nations of Egypt.
All the earth is called to make a joyful noise, with the lyre and the harp.
Flutes and pipes join in, and the sea, the rivers and the mountains are called to rejoice.

wrong_details.true: Trumpets and the blast of the ram's horn

lines.text: Creation rejoices before the LORD because He comes to judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.
